# ZOE — account brief

## Who

ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as ZOE at joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is committed in joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app runs react-native 0.74.5 per package.json ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 16 public repos and 88 followers ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- joinzoe/zoe-app was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)).
- The iOS app has 22,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- There were 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- The GitHub org description names a regulated category, health ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- ZOE was listed in "Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)" on 2026-08-03 ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45121440)) and in the July 2026 thread on 2026-07-01 ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44890211)). Neither record says what roles are open.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), top contributor to joinzoe/zoe-app with 121 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). No title or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). No title or location listed.
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). No title or location listed.

## Why now

joinzoe/zoe-app was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)), and the iOS app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — you have 121 commits in joinzoe/zoe-app, which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1), [source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)). The repo also has its own CI workflows, and the iOS app went out 8 times in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows), [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). Across those 8 releases, which steps run in your workflows and which run on EAS, and when a fix has to reach users, does it go over the air or wait for review?
